title: Simplifying Fractions Worksheets
intro: Explain simplifying as renaming the same fraction.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Use a strip to group equal small pieces into larger pieces. Connect the model to dividing both numerator and denominator by a common factor.

Ask your student

How can we tell that the amount has stayed the same?

If your student needs help

If only one part of the fraction is divided, compare the result with the original model.
